name: iron
description: Iron is a robust elemental metal, celebrated for its exceptional strength and versatility. Essential in construction, tool-making, and weaponry, iron forms the backbone of many modern and ancient applications.

allomancy.description: Grants sight to metals around {PAWN} and can pull on metals. Useful for drawing weapons or finding hidden metals.

feruchemy.description: Stores weight, allowing the user to become lighter or heavier.

store.description: This pawn is storing physical weight in an iron metalmind, becoming unnaturally light. They move faster and tire less on their feet, but a body with no mass behind it lands weak blows and is knocked off balance by anything that touches it.

tap.description: This pawn is tapping an iron metalmind, dramatically increasing their weight. Every step costs them, but a blow carrying that much mass lands like a falling wall, and almost nothing can knock them off their feet.
